name: Fluffy pancakes with {fruit}
steps: Whisk flour, baking powder, sugar and a pinch of salt in a bowl.
Beat in the {milk}, {eggs} and a little melted butter until just combined (lumps are fine).
Ladle onto a hot buttered pan, drop a few pieces of {fruit} on top and flip when bubbles appear.
Stack them high and serve with more {fruit} and maple syrup.

name: Mini {base} pizzas with {veg}[ & {protein}]
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F and lay the {base} on a baking sheet.
Spread each with pizza sauce and sprinkle with Italian seasoning.
Let everyone build their own with sliced {veg}[, {protein}] and a handful of {cheese}.
Bake 8-10 minutes until the cheese is bubbly and the edges are crisp.

name: {protein} sloppy joes[ with {veg}]
steps: Brown the {protein} with diced onion and garlic in a little oil, breaking it up.
[Stir in finely chopped {veg} and cook 3 minutes.]
Add the {tomatoes}, a big squeeze of ketchup, a spoon of brown sugar, mustard and Worcestershire.
Simmer 10-15 minutes until thick and saucy.
Pile onto toasted {buns} and hand out lots of napkins.

name: Crispy {protein} fingers with {starch} fries[ & {veg}]
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Cut the {starch} into fries, toss with oil and salt, and start roasting on a sheet pan.
Slice the {protein} into strips; dip in flour, then beaten {eggs}, then breadcrumbs mixed with paprika and garlic powder.
Lay the fingers on a second oiled pan and bake 15-18 minutes, flipping once, until golden and cooked through.
Flip the fries halfway so they crisp evenly.
[Cut {veg} into sticks and] serve with ketchup for dipping.

name: Frozen yogurt bark with {fruit}[ & {crunch}]
steps: Line a baking sheet with parchment.
Stir a drizzle of honey and a splash of vanilla into the {yogurt}, then spread it about 1 cm thick.
Scatter chopped {fruit}[ and {crunch}] over the top and press in lightly.
Freeze at least 2 hours, then snap into pieces and keep frozen.

name: Ants on a log
steps: Wash the {celery} and cut into 3-inch logs.
Fill each groove with {spread}.
Line up raisins on top as the ants and serve right away.

name: Sausage, egg & {cheese} breakfast sandwiches on {bread}
steps: Squeeze {protein} from casings (or season ground meat with sage, salt and pepper) and press into thin patties.
Fry patties 3-4 min per side until cooked through.
Fry eggs in butter in the same pan and lay {cheese} on top to melt.
Toast and butter {bread}, then stack with a patty and a cheesy egg.

name: Eggs Benedict with ham[ & {greens}]
steps: Whisk 2 yolks with lemon juice over a pot of simmering water, then slowly whisk in melted butter until thick; season with salt and cayenne.
Poach eggs in gently simmering water with a splash of vinegar for 3 min.
Warm the ham in a pan[ and wilt {greens} in butter].
Toast {bread} and top with ham[, {greens}], a poached egg and plenty of hollandaise.

name: Chocolate chip banana bread[ with {nuts}]
steps: Heat oven to 350°F and grease a loaf pan.
Mash very ripe {fruit} and whisk with melted butter, brown sugar, eggs and vanilla.
Stir in flour, baking soda and salt just until combined, then fold in chocolate chips[ and chopped {nuts}].
Bake 55-60 min until a toothpick comes out clean; cool before slicing.

name: Diner breakfast with {protein}, fried eggs & {starch} home fries
steps: Dice {starch} and parboil 5 min, then drain well.
Fry in oil and butter with onion[ and {veg}] until crispy, about 15 min; season with paprika, salt and pepper.
Meanwhile cook {protein} in another pan until browned.
Fry eggs to your liking and serve everything together[ with buttered {bread}].

name: Grilled {cheese} sandwiches with tomato soup
steps: Soften onion and garlic in butter, add {tomatoes}, broth and a pinch of sugar; simmer 10 min.
Blend smooth, stir in {milk} and season with salt and pepper.
Butter the outside of the bread, fill generously with {cheese}.
Fry sandwiches over medium heat until golden and melty, about 3 min per side, and serve with the soup for dunking.

name: Cheesy tuna melts on {bread}[ with {veg}]
steps: Mix drained tuna with mayo, a little dijon, salt and pepper.
Butter {bread} and toast lightly in a pan or under the broiler.
Pile on the tuna[, add {veg}] and cover with {cheese}.
Broil 2-3 min until bubbling and golden.

name: Chili cheese dogs with {meat} chili
steps: Brown {meat} with onion, then add chili powder, cumin and {tomatoes}; simmer 15 min until thick.
Grill or pan-fry {protein} until browned all over.
Warm the buns, tuck in the dogs and spoon chili over top.
Smother with shredded {cheese} and finish with mustard.

name: Monte Cristo sandwiches with ham & {cheese}
steps: Spread bread with a little dijon and layer with ham and {cheese}.
Whisk eggs with {milk} and dip each sandwich on both sides.
Fry in plenty of butter over medium heat until golden and the cheese melts, 3-4 min per side.
Dust with icing sugar and serve with jam for dipping.

name: Crispy chicken parm subs with {cheese}
steps: Simmer {tomatoes} with garlic, Italian seasoning and salt for 10 min to make a quick sauce.
Pound {protein} thin, dredge in flour, beaten egg, then breadcrumbs mixed with parmesan.
Shallow-fry in oil until golden and cooked through, 4-5 min per side.
Load into buns with sauce and {cheese}, then broil until bubbly.

name: Loaded poutine with {cheese}[ & {protein}]
steps: Cut {starch} into thick fries, toss with oil and salt, and bake at 450°F for 30-35 min, flipping once.
Melt butter, whisk in flour for 2 min, then slowly whisk in broth and Worcestershire; simmer until glossy and thick.
[Shred or brown the {protein} while the fries bake.]
Pile hot fries with torn {cheese}[ and {protein}] and pour over the hot gravy right before eating.

name: Baked mac & cheese[ with {veg}]
steps: Heat oven to 375°F and boil the pasta until just shy of al dente[, adding {veg} for the last 2 min]; drain.
Melt butter, whisk in flour, then slowly add {milk} and simmer until thickened.
Stir in most of the {cheese}, dry mustard, salt and pepper until smooth, then fold in the pasta.
Tip into a baking dish, top with remaining cheese and buttery breadcrumbs, and bake 20 min until golden.

name: Cheesy {protein} lasagna[ with {greens}]
steps: Brown {protein} with onion and garlic, add {tomatoes} and Italian seasoning, and simmer 20 min.
Boil lasagna noodles until just tender; mix ricotta with egg and parmesan[ and chopped {greens}].
Layer sauce, noodles, ricotta mix and {cheese} in a baking dish, finishing with sauce and lots of cheese.
Cover with foil and bake at 375°F for 30 min, uncover for 15 more, and rest 10 min before cutting.

name: {protein} shepherd's pie with {veg}
steps: Boil {starch} until tender, then mash with lots of butter and {milk}.
Brown {protein} with onion and garlic, stir in flour, tomato paste, Worcestershire, broth and thyme; simmer until thick.
Stir {veg} into the filling and spread in a baking dish.
Top with the mash[ and shredded {cheese}] and bake at 400°F for 25 min until golden.

name: Creamy {protein} fettuccine Alfredo[ with {veg}]
steps: Season and pan-fry {protein} in butter until cooked through, then slice and set aside.
Boil the pasta[, adding {veg} for the last 3 min]; save a cup of pasta water.
Melt butter with garlic, add cream and {milk}, simmer 3 min, then whisk in lots of parmesan.
Toss in pasta and {protein}, loosening with pasta water, and finish with black pepper.

name: Crispy sweet & sour {protein} with {veg} over {starch}
steps: Cook {starch} and keep warm.
Cut {protein} into bite-size pieces, dip in beaten egg, toss in cornstarch and flour, and fry in hot oil until crisp.
Stir-fry {veg} and garlic for 3 min, then add ketchup, vinegar, brown sugar, soy, pineapple and a cornstarch slurry; simmer until glossy.
Toss the crispy {protein} in the sauce and serve right away over {starch}.

name: Loaded nachos with {protein} & {cheese}
steps: Spread the {wraps} on a sheet pan. Tortillas need cutting into wedges, brushing with oil and baking at 400°F for 8-10 min until crisp first.
Cook {protein} with taco seasoning and a splash of water.
Spread chips on a sheet pan, top with {protein} and a thick layer of {cheese}, and bake 5 min until melted.
Finish with[ diced {veg},] salsa, sour cream and jalapeños.

name: Homemade mozzarella sticks with marinara
steps: Cut {cheese} into thick sticks.
Coat in flour, beaten egg, then seasoned breadcrumbs; dip in egg and crumbs again for a double coat.
Freeze 30 min so they hold their shape, and meanwhile simmer {tomatoes} with garlic powder and Italian seasoning for a dip.
Fry in hot oil 1-2 min until golden, drain and serve with the marinara.

name: Chocolate-dipped {fruit}[ with {nuts}]
steps: Wash and dry {fruit} well, cutting into slices or wedges if large.
Melt chocolate chips with a little coconut oil in short bursts in the microwave.
Dip the fruit halfway and roll in[ chopped {nuts} or] sprinkles.
Set on parchment and chill 10 min until firm.

name: Loaded potato skins with {cheese}[ & {protein}]
steps: Rub {starch} with oil and salt and bake at 425°F for 45 min until tender.
Halve and scoop out most of the flesh, leaving a thin shell; brush with melted butter and bake 10 min until crisp.
[Crumble and brown the {protein} while the skins crisp.]
Fill with {cheese}[ and {protein}], bake 5 min until melted, and top with sour cream and green onions.

name: Warm {fruit} crisp
steps: Heat oven to 375°F; slice {fruit} if needed and toss with lemon juice, a spoon of flour, cinnamon and a little brown sugar.
Rub cold butter into oats, flour, brown sugar and a pinch of salt until clumpy.
Spread fruit in a baking dish and scatter the topping thickly over it.
Bake 35-40 min until bubbling and golden; serve warm, with ice cream if you like.

name: {cookies} & a glass of milk
steps: Pour a cold glass of {milk} and serve with a few {cookies}.

name: Homemade chocolate chip cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and line two baking sheets.
Cream 1 cup soft butter with 3/4 cup each brown and white sugar, then beat in 2 {eggs} and 1 tsp vanilla.
Stir in 2 1/4 cups flour, 1 tsp baking soda and 1/2 tsp salt, then fold in 2 cups chopped {chocolate}.
Scoop tablespoons onto the sheets and bake 9 to 11 minutes, until golden at the edges.
Cool 5 minutes on the sheet; extras freeze well.

name: {icecream} sundaes[ with {fruit}]
steps: Scoop the {icecream} into bowls.
Top with sliced {fruit}, a drizzle of chocolate sauce and sprinkles.

name: {chips} with salsa[ & {dip}]
steps: Pour the {chips} into a bowl and serve with salsa and {dip} for dipping.

name: Shakshuka with {veg}[ & {cheese}] and warm {bread}
steps: Soften onion, garlic and sliced {veg} in olive oil for 5 minutes.
Stir in cumin, paprika and chili flakes, then add the {tomato} and simmer 8 minutes until thick.
Make little wells and crack in the eggs; cover and cook 5-6 minutes until the whites set.
Scatter over [{cheese} and ]serve straight from the pan with warm {bread} for dipping.

name: Huevos rancheros with {beans}[ & {cheese}]
steps: Simmer the {tomato} with onion, garlic, cumin and chili powder for 8 minutes to make a quick ranchero sauce.
Warm the {beans} in a small pot and mash lightly with a pinch of salt.
Crisp the tortillas in a dry pan and fry the eggs sunny-side up.
Top each tortilla with {beans}, an egg and spoonfuls of sauce[, then sprinkle with {cheese}].

name: Sweet crêpes with {fruit}[ & {topping}]
steps: Whisk flour, eggs, milk, a little sugar, melted butter and vanilla into a thin batter; rest 5 minutes.
Swirl a ladle of batter into a hot buttered pan and cook 1 minute per side.
Spread each crêpe with chocolate-hazelnut spread and fill with {fruit}.
Fold into quarters and serve warm[ with a dollop of {topping}].

name: Turkish eggs with garlic yogurt on {bread}[ & {greens}]
steps: Stir grated garlic, a squeeze of lemon and salt into the yogurt and spread it on plates.
Poach the eggs in gently simmering water for 3-4 minutes.
Melt butter with paprika and chili flakes until sizzling[; wilt the {greens} in a dry pan].
Set eggs on the yogurt[ with the {greens}], drizzle with chili butter and dill, and serve with toasted {bread}.

name: {protein} shawarma pitas with {veg}[ & {veg2}]
steps: Toss sliced {protein} with olive oil, garlic, lemon, cumin, paprika, turmeric and a pinch of cinnamon.
Sear in a hot pan or roast at 425°F until charred and cooked through, about 15 minutes.
Mix the {sauce} with garlic, lemon and salt for a quick garlic sauce.
Warm the {wraps}, then fill with {protein}, {veg}[, {veg2}] and plenty of garlic sauce.

name: {protein} banh mi sandwiches with pickled {veg}
steps: Cut the {veg} into thin matchsticks and soak in rice vinegar, sugar and salt for 15 minutes.
Slice the {protein} thinly and toss with soy sauce, fish sauce, garlic and a pinch of sugar.
Stir-fry over high heat until caramelized and cooked through.
Spread toasted {bread} with sriracha mayo, then pile in {protein}, pickled {veg}[, {veg2}] and cilantro.

name: Crispy falafel wraps with {veg}[ & {dip}]
steps: Pulse drained {chickpeas} with onion, garlic, parsley, cumin, coriander, a spoon of flour and baking powder until coarse.
Shape into small patties and chill 10 minutes.
Pan-fry in a little oil for 3 minutes per side until deep golden.
Fill warm {wraps} with {greens}, {veg} and the falafel[, then add a spoonful of {dip}].

name: Spicy {protein} sushi bowls with {veg}[ & {veg2}]
steps: Cook the rice and season with rice vinegar, a pinch of sugar and salt.
Mix the {protein} with mayonnaise, sriracha and a splash of soy sauce (sear fresh salmon or shrimp first).
Slice the {veg}[ and {veg2}] into thin strips.
Spoon rice into bowls, top with spicy {protein} and the veg, then finish with sesame seeds and torn nori.

name: Quick {protein} ramen with {greens}[ & {veg}]
steps: Simmer broth with garlic, ginger, soy sauce and a spoon of miso for 10 minutes.
Soft-boil the eggs for 6.5 minutes, then cool and peel.
Cook the {protein} in the broth until done (or just warm through if precooked)[ along with the {veg}].
Cook the noodles, divide into bowls, add {greens} and ladle over the hot broth.
Top with halved eggs, green onion and a drizzle of sesame oil.

name: {protein} pad thai with {veg}[ & {nuts}]
steps: Cook the noodles until just tender, rinse and toss with a little oil.
Whisk fish sauce, brown sugar, ketchup and lime juice into a sauce.
Stir-fry garlic and {protein} in a hot pan, then add the {veg} for 2 minutes.
Push aside, scramble the eggs, then toss in the noodles and sauce until glossy.
Serve with lime wedges, green onion[ and chopped {nuts}].

name: Korean {protein} bulgogi bowls with {veg}[ & {veg2}]
steps: Cook the rice.
Brown the {protein} in a hot pan, breaking it up, and drain any excess fat.
Add garlic, ginger, soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil and a spoon of gochujang; simmer 2 minutes until sticky.
Stir-fry the {veg} separately until tender-crisp.
Serve the bulgogi over rice with the {veg}[, sliced {veg2}], green onion and sesame seeds.

name: {protein} souvlaki with tzatziki, {starch} & {veg}
steps: Cube the {protein} and marinate in olive oil, lemon, garlic and oregano for at least 10 minutes.
Roast lemony {starch} wedges at 425°F (or cook the rice) while you thread the meat onto skewers.
Grill or broil the skewers 10-12 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Grate the {cucumber} into the {yogurt} with garlic, dill and salt for tzatziki.
Serve skewers with {starch}, chopped {veg}[, warm {pitas}] and tzatziki.

name: Teriyaki {protein} with {veg} over {starch}
steps: Cook the {starch}.
Simmer soy sauce, honey, garlic, ginger and rice vinegar, then thicken with a little cornstarch slurry.
Sear the {protein} in a hot oiled pan until cooked through, then brush generously with teriyaki sauce.
Steam or stir-fry the {veg} until tender-crisp.
Serve over {starch}, spoon over extra sauce and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

name: {protein} jambalaya with {veg}[ & {protein2}]
steps: Brown sliced {protein} in a large pot, then remove.
Soften onion, garlic and chopped {veg} in the drippings with cajun seasoning.
Stir in the rice, {tomato}, broth and a bay leaf; return the {protein}, cover and simmer 20 minutes.
[Tuck in the {protein2} for the last 5-8 minutes until cooked through. ]Fluff and season with hot sauce to taste.

name: {protein} lettuce wraps with {veg}[ & {rice}]
steps: [Start the {rice} cooking. ]Finely chop the {veg}.
Brown the {protein} with garlic and ginger, breaking it into small pieces (crumble tofu if using).
Add the {veg} and cook 3 minutes, then stir in hoisin, soy sauce and rice vinegar.
Spoon into crisp lettuce cups and top with green onion and a drizzle of sesame oil.

name: Thai peanut noodles with {protein} & {veg}[ & {veg2}]
steps: Cook the {noodles} and save a splash of the cooking water.
Whisk {spread} with soy sauce, lime, honey, sriracha, garlic and hot water until smooth.
Cook the {protein} in a hot pan until done, then add the {veg} for 2-3 minutes.
Toss the noodles with the sauce, {protein} and {veg}[, then top with crunchy {veg2}].

name: Sweet {fruit} lassi
steps: Add the {fruit}, {yogurt} and {milk} to a blender (frozen mango is classic).
Add a drizzle of honey and a pinch of cardamom.
Blend until thick and frothy, adding ice to chill.
Pour into glasses and dust with a little more cardamom.

name: Cinnamon-sugar tortilla chips with {fruit}[ & {fruit2}] salsa
steps: Brush tortillas with melted butter, sprinkle with cinnamon sugar and cut into wedges.
Bake at 375°F for 8-10 minutes until crisp and golden.
Dice the {fruit}[ and {fruit2}] and toss with lime juice and a drizzle of honey.
Scoop the fruit salsa with the warm chips.

name: Coconut sticky rice with {fruit}
steps: Cook the rice until soft and slightly sticky.
Warm coconut milk with sugar and a pinch of salt until dissolved.
Stir most of the coconut sauce into the hot rice and let it soak 10 minutes.
Serve with sliced or thawed {fruit}, the remaining sauce and a sprinkle of sesame seeds.

name: Crispy masala roasted chickpeas[ & {nuts}]
steps: Drain, rinse and pat the chickpeas very dry.
Toss with olive oil, garam masala, cumin, chili powder and salt.
Roast at 400°F for 25-30 minutes, shaking halfway, until crunchy[; add the {nuts} for the last 5 minutes].
Finish with a squeeze of lime and cool before snacking.

name: Christmas morning breakfast strata with {protein} & {veg}
steps: Brown the {protein} in a skillet, then add the {veg} and cook until soft.
Cube the {bread} and spread it in a buttered baking dish with the {protein} mixture and {cheese}.
Whisk the eggs with the milk, mustard, salt and pepper and pour over everything.
Cover and refrigerate overnight (or at least 30 minutes).
Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes until puffed and golden.

name: Glazed orange scones[ with {fruit}]
steps: Zest and juice the oranges.
Rub cold butter into flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and the zest.
Stir in the {milk}[ and fold in the {fruit}] until a shaggy dough forms.
Pat into a circle, cut into wedges and bake at 400°F for 18-20 minutes.
Whisk icing sugar with orange juice and drizzle over the cooled scones.

name: Gingerbread baked oatmeal with {fruit}
steps: Chop the {fruit} and spread it in a greased baking dish.
Mix oats, baking powder, ginger, cinnamon and salt in a bowl.
Whisk the milk, eggs, molasses and maple syrup, then stir into the oats.
Pour over the {fruit} and bake at 375°F for 35 minutes until set.

name: {starch} & {protein} breakfast hash with eggs[ and {veg}]
steps: Dice the {starch} and fry in oil with onion for 12-15 minutes until tender and crisp.
Add the {protein}[ and {veg}] and cook until browned.
Season with paprika, salt and pepper.
Make wells in the hash, crack in the eggs, cover and cook until the whites set.

name: Gingerbread waffles with {fruit}[ & {topping}]
steps: Whisk flour, brown sugar, ginger, cinnamon and baking powder.
Beat in the eggs, milk, molasses and melted butter until just combined.
Cook in a hot greased waffle iron until crisp.
Top with sliced {fruit}[, a spoonful of {topping}] and maple syrup.

name: Cozy {protein} & {starch} soup with {veg}[ & {greens}]
steps: Soften onion, garlic and the {veg} in a big pot.
Add broth, thyme and bay leaf and bring to a simmer.
Stir in the {starch} and cook until tender.
Add the shredded or diced {protein}[ and {greens}] and simmer 5 more minutes; season to taste.

name: Roasted {veg}[ & {fruit}] soup with warm {bread}
steps: Cube the {veg}[ and {fruit}], toss with oil, onion and garlic and roast at 425°F for 30 minutes.
Transfer to a pot with broth and simmer 5 minutes.
Blend until smooth and season with nutmeg and salt.
Serve with buttered, warmed {bread}.

name: Hearty lentil soup with {veg}[ & {protein}]
steps: Sauté onion, garlic and the {veg} in oil until soft[, then add the chopped {protein}].
Stir in rinsed lentils, canned tomatoes, broth, cumin and thyme.
Simmer 30 minutes until the lentils are tender.
Season and serve, or cool and freeze in portions.

name: {protein} Waldorf salad with {fruit}[ & {nuts}]
steps: Dice the {protein}, {fruit} and celery.
Toss with mayonnaise, a squeeze of lemon, salt and pepper[ and the chopped {nuts}].
Spoon over the {greens} or into lettuce cups.

name: {protein} pot pie with {veg}[ & {starch}]
steps: Cook the diced {protein} in butter with onion[ and cubed {starch}] until cooked through.
Sprinkle in flour, then stir in broth and milk until thick and creamy.
Add the {veg} and thyme and season well.
Pour into a pie dish, top with crust and cut a few slits.
Bake at 400°F for 30 minutes until golden.

name: Classic {protein} tourtière[ with {greens} salad]
steps: Boil the peeled potatoes until soft and mash.
Brown the {protein} with onion and garlic, then add broth and the spices and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir the mashed potatoes into the meat to bind the filling.
Fill a pie crust, cover with a top crust, crimp and cut vents.
Bake at 400°F for 35-40 minutes[ and serve with a {greens} salad].

name: Swedish {protein} meatballs over {starch}[ with {veg}]
steps: Mix the {protein} with egg, breadcrumbs, grated onion, allspice and nutmeg; roll into small balls.
Brown the meatballs in butter and set aside.
Whisk flour into the pan, then add broth, milk and Worcestershire and simmer until thick.
Return the meatballs to the gravy and simmer 10 minutes.
Serve over cooked {starch}[ with steamed {veg}].

name: Cranberry-glazed {protein} meatloaf with mashed {starch} & {veg}
steps: Mix the {protein} with egg, breadcrumbs, onion, garlic, salt and pepper and shape into a loaf.
Spread with cranberry sauce stirred with a little ketchup.
Bake at 375°F for 55-60 minutes.
Meanwhile boil and mash the {starch} with butter and steam the {veg}.
Rest the meatloaf 10 minutes, then slice and serve.

name: Festive stuffed peppers with {protein} & {starch}
steps: Cook the {starch}; halve and seed red and green peppers.
Brown the {protein} with onion and garlic, then stir in the tomatoes, seasoning and cooked {starch}.
Pack the filling into the peppers in a baking dish.
Cover with foil and bake at 375°F for 30 minutes.
Top with {cheese} and bake uncovered 10 more minutes.

name: Herb-roasted {protein} with bread stuffing & {veg}
steps: Rub the {protein} with oil, sage, thyme, salt and pepper and roast at 425°F for 25-35 minutes until cooked through.
Meanwhile soften onion and celery in butter, toss with cubed {bread}, herbs and enough broth to moisten.
Bake the stuffing in a dish alongside for 25 minutes until crisp on top.
Toss the {veg} with oil and roast on a sheet pan for the last 20 minutes.

name: Classic deviled eggs[ with {veg} sticks]
steps: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, then cool in ice water and peel.
Halve them and mash the yolks with mayonnaise, mustard, salt and pepper.
Pipe or spoon the filling back into the whites and dust with paprika.
Serve chilled[ with {veg} sticks].

name: Shrimp cocktail[ with {veg}]
steps: Poach the shrimp in salted boiling water for 2-3 minutes until pink, then chill in ice water.
Stir ketchup with horseradish, lemon juice and a dash of hot sauce.
Arrange the shrimp around the sauce[ with {veg} sticks] and serve cold.

name: Homemade hot chocolate[ with {cookies}]
steps: Warm the milk in a pot until steaming.
Whisk in cocoa, sugar and the chopped chocolate until melted and smooth.
Add a splash of vanilla and pour into mugs.
Top with marshmallows[ and serve with {cookies} for dunking].

name: Maple-cinnamon candied nuts
steps: Toss the nuts with melted butter, maple syrup, brown sugar, cinnamon and a pinch of salt.
Spread on a lined baking sheet and roast at 325°F for 12-15 minutes, stirring once.
Cool completely so they crisp, then break apart and store in a jar.

name: Chewy ginger molasses cookies
steps: Cream butter and brown sugar, then beat in the egg and molasses.
Stir in flour, baking soda, ginger, cinnamon and cloves.
Roll into balls and coat in sugar.
Bake at 350°F for 9-10 minutes until crackled but still soft in the middle.

name: Egg-in-a-hole toast with {fruit}
steps: Use a cookie cutter or small cup to cut a fun shape from the middle of each slice of {bread}.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat and lay in the slices and cut-outs.
Crack an egg into each hole, season with salt and pepper and cook 2-3 minutes.
Flip carefully and cook 1 minute more, toasting the cut-outs on both sides.
Serve with {fruit} on the side and the cut-outs for dipping.

name: Fluffy muffins with {fruit}
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and line a muffin tin.
Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder and salt; in another bowl whisk eggs, milk, melted butter and vanilla.
Stir wet into dry until just combined, then fold in chopped {fruit}.
Let the kids scoop batter into the cups and sprinkle a little sugar on top.
Bake 20-22 minutes until golden; cool before serving.

name: Smoothie bowls with {fruit} & {crunch}
steps: Blend {base} with {yogurt} and a drizzle of honey until thick and spoonable.
Pour into bowls.
Slice {fruit} and let kids decorate the tops in stripes or faces.
Sprinkle with {crunch} and serve right away.

name: Breakfast banana splits with {fruit} & {crunch}
steps: Peel the bananas and split them lengthwise into a bowl or dish.
Add two or three scoops of {yogurt} between the banana halves like ice cream.
Top with chopped {fruit} and a sprinkle of {crunch}.
Drizzle with honey and dust with cinnamon.

name: Silly face {bread} with {fruit}[ & {veg}]
steps: Split and toast the {bread}.
Spread each half with cream cheese.
Slice {fruit}[ and {veg}] into eyes, noses, smiles and hair.
Let the kids build their own silly faces and eat.

name: {protein} & {cheese} pinwheels[ with {veg}]
steps: Spread each tortilla edge to edge with a thin layer of cream cheese.
Layer on {protein}, grated {cheese}[ and finely sliced {veg}].
Roll up tightly and wrap in plastic for a few minutes to firm up.
Slice into 1-inch pinwheels and secure with toothpicks for little hands.

name: {protein} pasta salad with {veg}[ & {cheese}]
steps: Cook fun-shaped {pasta} in salted water, then rinse under cold water and drain well.
Chop {protein} and {veg} into small bite-size pieces[ and cube the {cheese}].
Toss everything with Italian dressing, salt and pepper.
Chill 10 minutes or pack straight into lunch boxes.

name: Egg salad sandwiches on {bread}[ with {veg}]
steps: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, then cool in ice water and peel.
Mash the eggs with mayo, a little mustard, salt and pepper.
Spread onto {bread}[ and add {veg}].
Cut into triangles or use cookie cutters for fun shapes.

name: Pigs in a blanket with {veg} sticks
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and brown the sausages in a skillet until cooked through; cut in half.
Unroll the crescent dough and cut into thin triangles.
Lay a strip of cheese on each triangle if using, add a sausage piece and roll up.
Bake 12-15 minutes until puffed and golden.
Serve with ketchup, mustard and {veg} sticks.

name: Bean & {cheese} burritos[ with {veg}]
steps: Warm the {beans} in a pan with cumin, chili powder and a splash of water, mashing half of them.
Spoon onto warm tortillas and top with grated {cheese}[ and chopped {veg}].
Fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
Toast seam-side down in a hot pan until golden on both sides.
Serve with salsa and sour cream; extras freeze well.

name: Spaghetti & {protein} meatballs[ with {veg}]
steps: Mix {protein} with egg, breadcrumbs, parmesan, Italian seasoning and salt; let the kids roll into small balls.
Brown the meatballs in olive oil, then remove.
Soften onion and garlic, add {tomatoes} and simmer, then return the meatballs for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile cook the {pasta}[ and steam the {veg}].
Serve meatballs and sauce over the pasta with extra parmesan.

name: Crispy shake & bake {protein} with {starch} & {veg}
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F; cut {starch} into wedges, toss with oil and salt and start roasting (or cook rice on the stove).
Put breadcrumbs, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder and salt in a zip bag.
Brush {protein} lightly with oil, drop into the bag and let the kids shake to coat.
Bake on a rack 20-25 minutes until cooked through and crispy.
Steam or roast {veg} and serve alongside.

name: Cheesy baked ziti with {protein}[ & {veg}]
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and cook the {pasta} 2 minutes short of package time.
Brown {protein} with onion and garlic[, stir in {veg} until wilted], then add {tomatoes} and Italian seasoning and simmer 10 minutes.
Toss the pasta with the sauce and half the {cheese}, then spread in a baking dish.
Top with the remaining cheese and parmesan and bake 20 minutes until bubbly.

name: One-pot cheeseburger pasta with {protein}[ & {veg}]
steps: Brown {protein} with onion and garlic in a large pot; drain any fat.
Stir in paprika, a squeeze of ketchup and mustard, the broth and the dry {pasta}.
Cover and simmer 10-12 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is tender[; add {veg} for the last 5 minutes].
Stir in {milk} and grated {cheese} until creamy and melted.

name: Cheesy {protein}, {veg} & {starch} casserole
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and cook the {starch} in chicken broth.
Cook and chop the {protein} into bite-size pieces, and chop {veg} into small florets or pieces.
Make a quick sauce: melt butter, stir in flour, whisk in {milk} and cook until thick, then stir in most of the {cheese}.
Mix the starch, protein, veg and sauce in a baking dish, top with remaining cheese and bake 20-25 minutes until golden.

name: Walking tacos with {protein} & {cheese}
steps: Brown {protein} in a little oil, then stir in taco seasoning and a splash of water and simmer 5 minutes.
Chop {veg} and grate {cheese} into little bowls for a topping bar.
Gently crush single-serve chip bags (or portion chips into paper cups) and cut open the tops.
Spoon in the taco filling and let everyone add cheese, veg, salsa and sour cream, then eat with a fork.

name: Rainbow fruit kabobs with {fruit} & {fruit2}
steps: Cut {fruit} and {fruit2} into chunky bite-size pieces.
Let the kids thread the fruit onto skewers in colourful patterns (use blunt or snipped skewers for little ones).
Stir {yogurt} with a little honey and vanilla for dipping.
Serve the kabobs with the yogurt dip.

name: Homemade trail mix with {nuts}[ & {chocolate}]
steps: Set out {nuts}, {crunch}, raisins, pretzels and cereal[ plus {chocolate}] in bowls.
Let each kid scoop their own mix into a bag or jar.
Shake it up and store extras in an airtight container for the week.

name: Frozen {fruit} yogurt pops
steps: Blend half the {fruit} with {yogurt} and a little honey.
Chop the remaining fruit and drop a few pieces into popsicle moulds or small paper cups.
Pour in the yogurt mixture, add sticks and freeze at least 4 hours.
Run the moulds under warm water for a few seconds to pop them out.

name: Peanut butter banana sushi[ with {crunch}]
steps: Spread a tortilla with {spread} and drizzle with a little honey.
[Sprinkle with {crunch}, then ]lay a peeled banana at one edge and roll up tightly.
Slice into 1-inch 'sushi' rounds and dust with cinnamon.
Serve with chopsticks for fun.

name: Freezer breakfast burritos with {protein}[, {veg}] & {cheese}
steps: Brown the {protein} in a large skillet, breaking it up, then set aside.
Fry the diced {starch}[ and {veg}] in a little oil until tender and golden.
Scramble the {eggs} softly, then fold in the {protein} and {starch}.
Spoon onto {wraps}, top with {cheese} and a spoon of salsa, and roll up tightly.
Wrap each burrito in foil and freeze; microwave from frozen 2-3 minutes, turning halfway.

name: Make-ahead buttermilk waffles with {fruit}
steps: Stir a spoon of lemon juice into the {milk} and let it sit 5 minutes to sour.
Whisk flour, sugar and baking powder, then mix in the {milk}, {eggs}, melted butter and vanilla.
Cook in a hot greased waffle iron until crisp and golden.
Cool extras on a rack, freeze flat, then bag; reheat in the toaster.
Serve with {fruit} and maple syrup.

name: {protein} & {veg} quiche with {cheese}
steps: Heat oven to 375°F and sauté the onion and {veg} until soft.
Scatter the {protein}, {veg} and {cheese} into the pie crust.
Whisk the {eggs} with {milk}, salt, pepper and a pinch of nutmeg, then pour over.
Bake 35-40 minutes until just set in the centre.
Cool, slice and freeze wedges individually; reheat in the oven or microwave.

name: Hash brown egg cups with {protein}[ & {veg}]
steps: Heat oven to 400°F; grate the {starch}, squeeze dry and season.
Press into greased muffin cups and bake 15 minutes until crisp at the edges.
Fill with chopped {protein}[, {veg}] and {cheese}, then pour beaten {eggs} over.
Bake 12-15 minutes until set; cool and freeze in a bag, reheating in the microwave.

name: Homemade {protein} & {cheese} pizza pockets[ with {veg}]
steps: Heat oven to 400°F; cook the {protein} first if it's raw and chop everything small.
Roll pizza dough thin and cut into rectangles.
Spread a little sauce on half of each, add {protein}, {cheese}[ and {veg}], then fold and crimp with a fork.
Brush with oil, sprinkle Italian seasoning and bake 15-18 minutes until golden.
Cool completely, wrap and freeze; reheat in the oven or microwave.

name: Minestrone with {veg}, {beans}[ & {greens}]
steps: Soften onion and garlic in olive oil, then add the chopped {veg}.
Pour in the {tomato}, broth, Italian seasoning and drained {beans}; simmer 15 minutes.
Add the {starch} and cook until tender[, stirring in the {greens} at the end].
Serve with parmesan; freeze extra portions (pasta softens a little but reheats fine).

name: {protein} taco soup with {beans}[ & {cheese}]
steps: Brown the {protein} with onion and drain any fat.
Stir in taco seasoning, {tomato}, broth, {veg} and drained {beans}.
Simmer 20 minutes until thick and flavourful.
Serve with sour cream[ and {cheese}]; freeze cooled leftovers in portions.

name: Baked {protein} & {cheese} taquitos
steps: Heat oven to 425°F; shred the cooked {protein}.
Mix with cream cheese, a spoon of salsa, cumin, chili powder and the {cheese}.
Spread a line of filling on each warmed tortilla, roll tightly and place seam-side down.
Brush with oil and bake 15 minutes until crisp; freeze extras and bake from frozen.

name: {veg} cheddar soup[ with crusty {bread}]
steps: Melt butter, soften the onion, then stir in flour for a minute.
Whisk in broth and {milk}, then add chopped {veg}[ and grated {carrots}].
Simmer 15 minutes until tender and partly blend for a chunky texture.
Stir in the {cheese} off the heat until melted; freeze cooled portions.

name: {protein} enchiladas with {beans}[ & {veg}]
steps: Cook the {protein} with onion and cumin, shredding or crumbling it as it cooks.
Stir in the drained {beans}[, {veg}] and a splash of enchilada sauce.
Fill and roll the tortillas, then pack seam-side down in a baking dish.
Cover with remaining sauce and {cheese}; bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.
To freeze, assemble unbaked, cover tightly and bake from thawed.

name: Creamy butter {protein} with {starch}[ & {bread}]
steps: Brown bite-sized {protein} in butter and set aside.
Cook onion, garlic, ginger and garam masala until fragrant, then add the {tomato} and simmer 10 minutes.
Blend smooth, stir in cream and return the {protein} to simmer until cooked through.
Serve over {starch}[ with warm {bread}]; the sauce freezes beautifully.

name: Hearty {protein} stew with {veg} & {starch}
steps: Toss cubed {protein} in flour and brown in oil in batches.
Soften onion, garlic[ and {celery}], then stir in tomato paste and thyme.
Add broth, the {protein}, chunks of {starch} and {veg}.
Cover and simmer about 45 minutes until thick and tender; freeze in portions.

name: Cheesy stuffed shells with {greens}[ & {protein}]
steps: Boil jumbo shells until just shy of al dente and drain.
Wilt the chopped {greens} with garlic[ and brown the {protein} in the same pan].
Mix ricotta, {eggs}, parmesan, half the {cheese} and the {greens}.
Spread sauce in a dish, fill the shells, top with more sauce[, the {protein}] and remaining {cheese}.
Bake at 375°F for 25 minutes, or cover and freeze unbaked.

name: {protein} & {veg} potstickers
steps: Mix the {protein} with finely chopped {veg}, ginger, garlic, green onion, soy sauce and sesame oil.
Spoon a little onto each wrapper, wet the edges and pleat shut.
Freeze extras on a tray, then bag them.
Fry in oil until golden on the bottom, add a splash of water, cover and steam 5 minutes (a few more from frozen).
Serve with soy sauce mixed with rice vinegar.

name: Creamy {protein} stroganoff with {veg} over {starch}
steps: Cook the {starch} according to the package.
Brown the {protein} (sliced thin if not ground), then add butter, onion, garlic and sliced {veg}.
Sprinkle in flour, then stir in broth and Worcestershire and simmer until thickened.
Take off the heat and stir in sour cream; serve over {starch}.
Freeze the sauce on its own and add a fresh spoon of sour cream when reheating.

name: Cookie ice cream sandwiches[ rolled in {crunch}]
steps: Let the {icecream} soften on the counter for 5 minutes.
Sandwich a scoop between two {cookies} and press gently.
Roll the edges in sprinkles[ or chopped {crunch}].
Wrap each in plastic and freeze at least an hour before eating.

name: Chewy homemade granola bars[ with {mixin}]
steps: Warm the {spread}, honey and butter together until smooth, then add vanilla and a pinch of salt.
Stir in the {oats} and cinnamon[, then fold in the {mixin}].
Press firmly into a lined pan and chill until set.
Cut into bars, wrap individually and freeze for grab-and-go snacks.

name: Banana nice cream with {fruit}[ & {spread}]
steps: Slice ripe {bananas} and freeze them solid (keep a bag ready in the freezer).
Blend the frozen bananas with the {fruit}[, the {spread}] and a drop of vanilla until creamy like soft-serve.
Eat right away, or freeze 30 minutes for scoopable nice cream.

name: Grated {veg} muffins[ with {chocolate} chips]
steps: Heat oven to 350°F and grate the {veg}, squeezing out extra moisture.
Whisk {eggs}, oil, brown sugar and vanilla, then stir in the {veg}.
Fold in flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt[ plus the {chocolate}] until just combined.
Bake in lined muffin cups 20-22 minutes; cool and freeze, thawing one at a time for lunches.

name: {veg} & {cheese} omelette[ with {greens}]
steps: Chop the {veg} small and sauté in a little butter until tender[, then wilt in the {greens}]; set aside.
Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Melt butter in a non-stick pan over medium-low, pour in the eggs and swirl.
When almost set, scatter the veg and {cheese} over one half.
Fold, slide onto a plate and finish with hot sauce.

name: Egg & {beans} breakfast tacos with {veg}[ & {cheese}]
steps: Drain and rinse the {beans}, then warm them in a pan with a pinch of chili powder, mashing a few.
Dice the {veg}.
Scramble the eggs softly in a little oil and season with salt.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or microwave.
Fill with beans, eggs and {veg}[, sprinkle with {cheese}] and top with salsa.

name: Breakfast-stuffed {starch} with eggs[ & {greens}]
steps: Prick the {starch} and microwave 8-10 minutes, turning halfway, until soft.
Meanwhile scramble the eggs in butter[ and stir in the {greens} until wilted].
Split the potatoes open and fluff the insides with a fork and a pinch of salt.
Pile in the eggs[, crumble over the {cheese}] and finish with hot sauce and chili flakes.

name: Banana oat breakfast cookies[ with {mixin}]
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and line a baking sheet.
Mash the bananas, then stir in the peanut butter, maple syrup, vanilla and cinnamon.
Mix in the oats, baking powder and a pinch of salt[, then fold in the {mixin}].
Scoop onto the sheet, flatten slightly and bake 12-15 minutes until golden.
Cool on the pan; keeps 4 days in a tin or freezes well.

name: {protein} Caesar salad with homemade croutons
steps: Cube the bread, toss with olive oil and toast in a hot pan until crisp.
Cook or shred the {protein} (pan-sear raw meat or fish; roast chickpeas until crunchy; boil eggs).
Chop the {greens}, massaging kale with a squeeze of lemon if using.
Toss the greens with Caesar dressing and a handful of parmesan.
Top with the {protein}, croutons, more parmesan and cracked pepper.

name: {protein} burrito bowls with {beans} & {veg}[ & {cheese}]
steps: Cook the {starch} and stir in a squeeze of lime.
Season the {protein} with taco seasoning and cook in a hot oiled pan until done; slice or crumble.
Warm the drained {beans} with a spoonful of salsa.
Dice the {veg}.
Build bowls with starch, protein, beans and veg[, top with {cheese}], plus salsa and sour cream.
Pack leftovers in containers for lunches all week.

name: Greek {protein} salad with {veg}, {veg2} & {cheese}[ and warm {bread}]
steps: Chop the {veg} and {veg2} into big chunks and thinly slice a little red onion.
Drain and rinse chickpeas, or flake the tuna or shred the chicken.
Whisk olive oil, red wine vinegar, oregano and salt.
Toss everything with olives and dressing, then top with slabs of {cheese}.
[Warm the {bread} in a dry pan and serve alongside.]

name: Egg drop soup with {veg}[ & {greens}]
steps: Bring broth to a simmer with grated ginger and a splash of soy sauce.
Add the {veg}[ and cubed tofu] and simmer 3-4 minutes until tender.
Stir in a cornstarch slurry to thicken slightly[, then add the {greens}].
Whisk the eggs, then drizzle slowly into the gently stirred soup to form ribbons.
Finish with sesame oil, white pepper and sliced green onions.

name: Cobb salad with {protein}, eggs & {veg}
steps: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool in cold water and quarter.
Chop the {greens} and spread on a platter or in bowls.
Dice the {protein}, {veg} and {cheese}.
Arrange everything in rows over the greens with a sprinkle of bacon bits.
Season and drizzle with ranch just before eating.

name: Stuffed zucchini boats with {protein}[ & {cheese}]
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Halve the zucchini lengthwise and scoop out the centres; chop the scooped flesh.
Brown the {protein} with onion, garlic and the chopped zucchini.
Stir in the canned tomatoes and Italian seasoning and simmer 5 minutes.
Fill the zucchini boats, top with parmesan[ and {cheese}], and bake 20 minutes until tender and bubbly.

name: Garlicky {protein} scampi with {starch}[ & {veg}]
steps: Cook the {starch} in salted water; save a cup of the cooking water.
[Cut the {veg} into ribbons or small pieces and sauté until just tender; set aside.]
Sizzle lots of garlic and chili flakes in butter and olive oil, add the {protein} (bite-size) and cook until just done.
Add lemon juice and a splash of pasta water, then toss in the drained pasta[ and {veg}].
Finish with parsley and more lemon.

name: Baked orange {protein} with {veg} over {starch}
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F and start the {starch}.
Cut the {protein} into bite-size pieces, toss in cornstarch and a little oil, and bake on a lined sheet 15-18 minutes until crisp, adding the {veg} for the last 10.
Simmer the zest and juice of the oranges with soy sauce, honey, garlic, ginger and rice vinegar; thicken with a cornstarch slurry.
Toss the crispy pieces in the sauce and serve over the starch with the veg and sesame seeds.

name: Cashew {protein} with {veg}[ & {veg2}] over {starch}
steps: Start the {starch}.
Toast the {nuts} in a dry wok until golden; tip out.
Stir-fry the {protein} in hot oil until browned and cooked; set aside.
Stir-fry the {veg}[ and {veg2}] with garlic and ginger until crisp-tender.
Return the protein, add soy, hoisin and a cornstarch slurry, toss until glossy, then fold in the nuts and serve over the starch.

name: Spaghetti bolognese with {protein} & {veg}
steps: Finely grate or chop the {veg} and soften with onion and garlic in olive oil.
Add the {protein} and brown well (rinse lentils first if using and add a splash of water).
Stir in tomato paste, canned tomatoes and Italian seasoning; simmer 20 minutes.
Cook the pasta, toss with the sauce and top with parmesan.
Freeze extra sauce for a fast weeknight.

name: Red lentil dal[ with {greens}] over {starch}[ & {bread}]
steps: Start the {starch}.
Soften onion, garlic and ginger in oil, then bloom the curry powder, cumin and turmeric for a minute.
Add the rinsed lentils, canned tomatoes, coconut milk and 2 cups water; simmer 20 minutes until thick and creamy.
[Stir in the {greens} until wilted.] Season with salt.
Serve over the starch[ with warm {bread}].

name: Crispy buffalo {veg} bites[ with {veg2} sticks]
steps: Heat the oven to 450°F and cut the {veg} into bite-size florets.
Whisk flour, water, garlic powder and salt into a thin batter and coat the florets.
Bake on a lined sheet 20 minutes, flipping once, until crisp at the edges.
Toss in hot sauce mixed with a little melted butter and bake 5 more minutes.
Serve with ranch[ and {veg2} sticks].

name: Crispy {greens} chips
steps: Heat the oven to 300°F.
Strip the {greens} from the stems, tear into chip-size pieces and dry very well.
Massage with a little olive oil, salt, garlic powder and nutritional yeast.
Spread in a single layer and bake 12-15 minutes until crisp but still green.

name: Chili-lime frozen {fruit}
steps: Wash and dry the {fruit} well; slice strawberries or bananas into bites.
Toss with a squeeze of lime and a light sprinkle of chili-lime seasoning (skip for kids).
Spread on a lined tray and freeze at least 2 hours.
Bag up and keep in the freezer for grab-and-go munchies.

name: {fruit} nachos with peanut butter & {crunch}[ & {chocolate}]
steps: Core and thinly slice the {fruit}; toss with a squeeze of lemon so it stays bright.
Fan the slices out on a plate like chips.
Warm the peanut butter for 15 seconds and drizzle over with a little honey.
Scatter with {crunch}[, {chocolate}] and a dusting of cinnamon.

name: Caprese skewers with {veg} & {cheese}
steps: Cut the {veg} and {cheese} into bite-size pieces.
Thread onto toothpicks or small skewers with a basil leaf between each.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Finish with a pinch of salt and cracked pepper.

name: Breakfast nachos with scrambled eggs, {protein} & {cheese}[ and {veg}]
steps: Brown the {protein} in a skillet, breaking it up, then set aside.
Soft-scramble the eggs in butter with a pinch of salt.
Spread {chips} on a sheet pan and top with eggs, {protein} and {cheese}.
Broil 2-3 minutes until the cheese is bubbly.
Finish with chopped {veg}, salsa, sour cream and hot sauce.

name: Biscuits & country gravy with {protein}
steps: Mix flour, baking powder and salt, cut in cold butter, then stir in a splash of {milk} until it just comes together.
Pat out, cut into biscuits and bake at 425°F for 12-15 minutes.
Meanwhile brown the {protein} crumbled in a skillet, then sprinkle over a few spoons of flour.
Slowly stir in the rest of the {milk} and simmer until thick; season with lots of pepper.
Split the biscuits and smother with gravy.

name: Puffy Dutch baby pancake with {fruit}
steps: Heat oven to 425°F with a cast-iron or oven-safe pan inside.
Blend eggs, {milk}, flour and vanilla until smooth.
Melt a big knob of butter in the hot pan, pour in the batter and bake 18-20 minutes until puffed and golden.
Top with {fruit}, a dusting of icing sugar and maple syrup.

name: Microwave mug eggs with {protein} & {cheese}[ on toasted {bread}]
steps: Butter a big mug, crack in the eggs and whisk with a fork.
Stir in chopped {protein}, {cheese}, salt and pepper.
Microwave 45 seconds, stir, then 30-45 seconds more until just set.
Eat straight from the mug or tip onto toasted {bread} with ketchup.

name: Baked {protein} & {cheese} sliders
steps: Heat oven to 350°F and slice the slab of {buns} in half without separating them.
Layer {protein} and {cheese} on the bottom half, then add the top.
Melt butter with mustard, worcestershire and onion powder and brush over the tops; sprinkle with poppy seeds.
Cover with foil and bake 10 minutes, then uncover and bake 5 more until golden.
Pull apart and serve warm.

name: {protein} Philly cheesesteaks with {veg}
steps: Fry sliced onion and {veg} in oil until soft and browned.
Add the {protein} (thinly sliced if using chicken) and cook through with worcestershire, salt and pepper.
Pile into portions in the pan and lay {cheese} on top until melted.
Scoop each cheesy pile into a mayo-swiped bun.

name: Buffalo {protein} wraps with {veg}[ & {cheese}]
steps: Shred the {protein} (cook it first if raw).
Toss with melted butter and hot sauce.
Lay on warm tortillas with {veg}, {cheese} and a drizzle of ranch.
Roll up tight and toast seam-side down in a dry pan for a minute.

name: Québec-style hot {protein} sandwiches with gravy & {veg}
steps: Make the gravy from the mix and keep it hot.
Warm the shredded {protein} in a splash of gravy (cook it first if raw).
Cook the {veg} and toss with a little butter.
Pile {protein} between two slices of bread, cut in half and drown in gravy with {veg} on the side.

name: Saucy sausage & {veg} buns[ with melted {cheese}]
steps: Brown the sausages in an oiled skillet, turning, until cooked through.
Push aside and fry sliced onion and {veg} with Italian seasoning until soft.
Stir in a squirt of ketchup and a splash of water to make it saucy.
Tuck sausages and veg into buns, top with {cheese} and finish with mustard.

name: Crunchwrap supremes with {protein}, {cheese}[ & {veg2}]
steps: Brown the {protein} with taco seasoning and a splash of water.
On a large tortilla, layer {protein}, {cheese}, a handful of {chips}, sour cream, {veg} and {veg2}.
Cap the centre with a small tortilla piece and fold the edges over in pleats.
Fry seam-side down in an oiled pan until golden, then flip and crisp the other side.
Slice in half and serve with salsa.

name: Cheesy {protein} hotdish with {veg} & crispy {starch}
steps: Heat oven to 400°F and brown the {protein} with chopped onion, salt and pepper.
Stir in the {veg} and cream of mushroom soup, then spread in a baking dish.
Cover with {cheese}, then top with thinly sliced {starch} tossed in oil (or a bag of frozen tots).
Bake 35-40 minutes until the top is crispy and golden.

name: Creamy {protein} noodle casserole with {veg}[ topped with crushed {chips}]
steps: Heat oven to 375°F and boil the {starch} until just shy of tender; drain.
Stir together cream of mushroom soup, {milk}, half the {cheese}, salt and pepper.
Fold in the {starch}, {protein} and {veg}, then tip into a baking dish.
Top with the rest of the cheese and crushed {chips} or buttered breadcrumbs.
Bake 20 minutes until bubbling.

name: One-pot creamy Cajun {protein} pasta[ with {veg}]
steps: Brown sliced {protein} in oil with Cajun seasoning, then set aside.
Soften onion, garlic and {veg} in the same pot.
Add the dry {starch}, chicken broth and {milk}; simmer, stirring, until the pasta is tender.
Stir in cream cheese and parmesan until silky, then return the {protein} to warm through.

name: Smothered {protein} in mushroom gravy with {starch}[ & {veg}]
steps: Season the {protein} and sear in oil until golden on both sides; set aside.
Fry sliced mushrooms in butter, then stir in cream of mushroom soup, onion soup mix and a splash of water.
Nestle the {protein} back in, cover and simmer 15 minutes until cooked through.
Meanwhile cook the {starch} (mash it if potatoes) and steam the {veg}.
Spoon lots of gravy over everything.

name: Cheesy {protein} meatball subs
steps: Mix the {protein} with breadcrumbs, parmesan, Italian seasoning and salt; roll into balls.
Brown the meatballs in oil, then add garlic and the canned tomatoes.
Simmer 15 minutes until the meatballs are cooked and the sauce thickens.
Load into split buns, top with {cheese} and broil until melted and bubbly.

name: Warm {cheese} queso[ with {tomato}] & tortilla chips
steps: Toss grated {cheese} with a spoon of cornstarch.
Warm {milk} with a little butter in a small pot over low heat.
Add the cheese a handful at a time, stirring until smooth.
Stir in chili powder, cumin, chopped jalapeños and drained {tomato}.
Serve hot with a big bowl of chips.

name: Skillet s'mores dip with {dipper}
steps: Heat oven to 450°F and butter a small cast-iron or oven-safe dish.
Spread the chocolate in an even layer and cover completely with marshmallows.
Bake 5-7 minutes until the marshmallows are toasted and golden.
Dig in with graham {dipper} or sliced fruit while it's gooey.

name: Thick milkshakes[ with {mixin}]
steps: Let the ice cream soften for a few minutes.
Blend ice cream, {milk}, a drop of vanilla and {mixin} until thick but still sippable.
Pour into tall glasses and top with whipped cream.

name: Gooey microwave mug brownie[ with {icecream}]
steps: In a big mug, stir flour, sugar, cocoa and a pinch of salt.
Mix in {milk}, oil and vanilla until smooth, then stir in a handful of chocolate.
Microwave 60-75 seconds until just set but still fudgy in the middle.
Let cool a minute and top with a scoop of {icecream}.

name: Cheesy garlic {bread}
steps: Heat oven to 425°F and mash soft butter with minced garlic, garlic powder and parsley.
Slice the {bread} open and spread thickly with the garlic butter.
Pile on {cheese} and bake 8-10 minutes until melted and golden at the edges.
Cut into strips and dunk in warm marinara.
